summary: User asked to fix a bug in the authentication module

message.content: Can you help me fix the login bug? Users are getting logged out randomly.
I'll help you investigate the login issue. Let me first look at your authentication code to understand the current implementation.
I found the issue. The session manager isn't persisting sessions across server restarts because it's using an in-memory Map. Let me fix this by adding proper session storage.
That makes sense. Can you also add session expiry?
I'll add session expiry with a configurable TTL. This will automatically invalidate old sessions.
